abasin.notes: We are open for the 2026/27 Season!As A-Basin celebrates its 80th anniversary this winter, the ski area will mark the occasionwith a season-long celebration of the people and culture that have shaped The Legend forgenerations. While much has changed over eight decades, the spirit of A-Basin remains thesame.All season long, join us in celebrating nearly a century of fantastic skiing and riding withevents, deals, giveaways, and more.80-Year-Olds Ski Free – You’ve been with us this whole time. So, in celebration of A-Basin'slegacy and yours, anyone who is 80 years old can ski free every Wednesday

copper.notes: Good morning and Happy Wednesday!No new snow to report this morning. For Thanksgiving Eve, we can expect bright, sunny skies with temps in the mid-30s at mid-mountain. Winds will be light out of the WSW, staying under 10mph throughout most of the day. Similar weather can be expected for Thanksgiving Day. Snow returns early Saturday morning with decent accumulations possible; stay tuned!Later this morning, we expect the Pitchfork lift and the Green Acres Beginner Area to open for the season, expanding our early season beginner terrain offerings. We'll have more terrain announcements to share la

eldora.notes: 5:30 AM update –Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Wednesday, November 25, 2026.Eldora is officially open for alpine skiing and riding! We couldn’t be more excited to welcome you, our devoted community members, back for another great season at your backyard mountain. We are so proud of our incredibly hardworking employees, whose relentless efforts have allowed us to open this week. They deserve a HUGE round of applause.Terrain:We'll have 1,000 vertical feet of downhill riding and skiing on Hornblower and International trails, from the summit of Challenge Mou
